offering_description.value: PROG Holdings offers lease-to-own financing for shoppers buying durable goods through retail partners. It sells merchandise through employer-sponsored payroll deduction programs. It also offers second-look revolving credit and buy now, pay later financing through merchant partners.

primary_products.value: Consumer electronics; appliances; furniture and mattresses sold through employer-sponsored purchase programs

primary_services.value: Point-of-sale lease-to-own; payroll deduction purchase programs; second-look revolving credit; buy now, pay later installment financing

customer_segment.value: B2C: Shoppers seeking flexible payments or with limited access to traditional credit, and employees eligible for payroll purchase programs; B2B: Brick-and-mortar and online merchants offering payment options to shoppers

end_markets.value: Consumer durable goods retail; employee voluntary benefits; e-commerce

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: Lease payments on merchandise selected at partner retailers; product sales: Merchandise purchases repaid through payroll deductions; interest or premiums: Interest on outstanding revolving credit balances; transaction or usage fees: Merchant fees on buy now, pay later purchases
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; product sales; interest or premiums; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: Buys retailer merchandise for consumer leases and works with lending partners to provide credit to shoppers; retailer: Sources merchandise from suppliers and sells it to employees through workplace purchase programs

specialization.value: related lines: Lease-to-own, payroll deduction purchasing, revolving credit, and buy now, pay later financing

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: Partner stores offering lease-to-own and credit at checkout; online: Merchant websites, consumer apps, and employee shopping portals; partners / resellers: Employers and benefits intermediaries offering payroll deduction purchase programs

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State consumer finance licensing and lease-purchase laws, federal consumer credit and fair lending rules, and state payroll deduction requirements
